mapper.select: SELECT * FROM bookings WHERE meeting_room_id = #{meetingRoomId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND ((start_time < #{endTime} AND end_time > #{startTime})) ORDER BY start_time
SELECT * FROM bookings WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY start_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bookings (id, meeting_room_id, user_id, subject, start_time, end_time, attendee_count, notes, status, checked_in_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{meetingRoomId}, #{userId}, #{subject}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{attendeeCount}, #{notes}, #{status}, #{checkedInAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE bookings SET meeting_room_id = #{meetingRoomId}, user_id = #{userId}, subject = #{subject}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, attendee_count = #{attendeeCount}, notes = #{notes}, status = #{status}, checked_in_at = #{checkedInAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
